paths.name: Server Files
paths.description: Persistent dedicated-server installation, world saves, configuration, and server data.

ports.name: UDP - Game Port
ports.description: DragonWilds game port. The host port, container port, and DEFAULT_PORT must match. If you change one, change all three to the same value.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User ID used by the container for file ownership. MOS documentation recommends 500 where supported.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group ID used by the container for file ownership. MOS documentation recommends 500 where supported.

variables.name: Owner Player ID
variables.description: REQUIRED. Your RuneScape: DragonWilds Player ID, found in-game at the bottom of the Settings menu. The server will not start without this value.

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: Display name of the dedicated server.

variables.name: Default World Name
variables.description: Name of the default world created on first startup.

variables.name: Admin Password
variables.description: REQUIRED. Password used to access Server Management in-game. The server will not start correctly without configuring this value.

variables.name: World Password
variables.description: Optional password players must enter to join. Leave empty for a public server.

variables.name: Game Port
variables.description: UDP port used by the server. This value must exactly match both the host and container port mapping.

variables.name: Maximum Players
variables.description: Maximum number of players allowed on the server.

variables.name: Update On Start
variables.description: When true, downloads/validates server files on container startup. Set to false to skip the update step.

variables.name: Multihome Address
variables.description: Optional IP address passed to the server with -MULTIHOME. Leave empty unless the host has multiple interfaces and you specifically need to bind one.
